english.note: For a person or group one knows without necessarily being close to, this is the all-purpose noun.

exampleSentences.english: That person is an acquaintance from my previous company.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰個係我以前公司嘅熟人。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 go3 hai6 ngo5 ji5 cin4 gung1 si1 ge3 suk6 jan4

english.note: Use this for an acquaintance, when the person is known but not really a friend.

exampleSentences.english: That acquaintance is a friend of my cousin.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰個熟人係我表哥嘅朋友。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 go3 suk6 jan4 hai6 ngo5 biu2 go1 ge3 pang4 jau5
